Import library / Community resources

How to import blueprints, layouts and AI

Use the correct import interface and check prerequisites.

Community imports: not live-tested. Check the stage, required modules and compatibility notes before importing. A published string is not a guarantee that it works in your version. Turbo Exec-dependent scripts are flagged as outdated.

Tower blueprints

Open Workshop or the Tower Testing blueprint interface, select Import, and paste the complete blueprint code. Confirm which modules are missing and replace them before running it.

Official blueprint builder

Power Plant layouts

Unlock the Yellowprints skill, then use the import functionality in the Power Plant. The imported layout still requires the corresponding component technology and enough yellow resources to construct.

Official Power Grid Designer

Facility AI scripts

Unlock AI at MT4, paste the import code into the game's AI import interface, enable the script/package, check its trigger impulses, and open the necessary building. Modify its settings where the author's instructions require it.

Facility AI mechanics and limitations

The official Perfect Tower II tools directory links the module database, blueprint builder, Factory planner, Power Grid designer, enemy calculator, and script editor. The earlier direct Factory Planner subpage link could not be independently verified; use this tools directory instead.
